title: Nautanki (Tech Skit)
rules:
• The Skit should be based on any one of the following themes:

1. Social media Addiction

2. Cyber frauds and security

3. AI-Ban or Allow?

  • Performance time: 6 to 8 minutes.
  • 5 marks will be deducted for exceeding the time limit.
  • The skit can be performed in English, Hindi or Konkani.
  • Offensive language, hurting of religious sentiments, or inappropriate gestures are strictly prohibited.
  • The content should be original.
  • Teams must arrange their own costumes, props, and music (if any). However, one desk and two chairs will be made available.
  • Pre-recorded music (if any) should be submitted in advance during registration, and one team member should be there to operate the music.
  • Any disputes or misconduct will lead to disqualification.
  • Use of fire, water, sharp objects, or any hazardous materials during the performance is strictly prohibited.
  • The judges' decision is final and binding.
judging:
• Creativity: 10mks
  • Relevance to the topic: 10mks
  • Execution (acting, coordination and expression): 20mks
  • Overall impact: 10mks
